decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions, the proposed installation of a new water storage unit, is acceptable as it would not harm the appearance of the area or the Metropolitan Open Land in which it is situated. It would also not have a harmful impact upon the living conditions of neighbours, thus complying with policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development) ENV-N.1.5 (Protection of Metropolitan Open Land) of the adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The development shall not be occupied until screen planting around the structure has been planted in accordance with a scheme submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing.
Condition : 5 - The water storage unit shall have a green colour exterior.
description: Installation of a new water storage unit to site.
